claims: The 2026 Masters garden gnome is sold exclusively at Augusta National Golf Club during tournament week.
Masters gnomes are limited to one per patron.
Roughly 1,000 Masters gnomes are released daily.
The 2026 gnome is only available in person at the Augusta National merchandise building during Masters week.
2026 Masters gnomes can fetch prices ranging from $500 to over $800 on eBay.
The 2016 inaugural gnome can command prices up to $18,000.
Full sets of Masters gnomes have been valued near $40,000.
The Masters gnome was introduced in 2016.
